newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE opens firmer after Dow advance.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE opens firmer after Dow advance.

text.p: UK's leading share index opened slightly firmer on Tuesday on the back of Wall Street's advance but dealers said investors were turning increasingly cautious.
The benchmark FTSE 100 share index was up 4.4 points to 4,691.1 at 0756 GMT, after hesitating at chart resistance at 4,700. Advancers were beating decliners by about three-to-one.
"No one seems prepared to sell this market, so it will just get squeezed higher," said one dealer.
The Dow rose 42.72 points to a record 7,478.50, giving the FTSE 100 an early lift.
